title: Inspecting a lexer's Python tools
description: You can connect rule pairs, pattern matches, generators and token records to their printed values.

steps.description: SPEC stores ordered name-pattern pairs. You select its first pair and then that pair's name, INT.
The digit pattern fails to match at position 0 in 'x = 42'. At position 4 it matches 42 and reports an end position of 6; search finds the digits by skipping ahead.
count_up yields one value per request. You consume 0 and 1 from the generator made with count_up(2).

steps.question: What happens when the next call requests a third value?
steps.answer: The generator has finished its loop, so next raises StopIteration. The handler prints that the generator is used up.

steps.description: A fresh count_up(3) produces [0, 1, 2]. You then see a Token record print its fields and compare equal to another Token with the same four values.
